'''NeMo-RL''' (NVIDIA, v0.7.0) supports LoRA GRPO, including MoE recipes (Nano v3 30B-A3B), multi-turn environments, and the GRPO, GSPO and DAPO losses.<ref>[https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL NeMo-RL repository]</ref> It ships a '''linux/arm64 NGC container''', which makes it one of the few RL stacks with a clear [[dgx-spark|Spark]] story. The trade-off is a heavy setup.
